newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds dip, seen staying nervous.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds dip, seen staying nervous.

text.p: 1710 GMT - Bonds ended down in line with the European trend after remarks by Buba chief Tietmeyer about the single currency unsettled the market. Trade seen continuing nervous on Friday. *Sept 97 futures down 27 basis points at 110.80 vs Weds close *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 102.45 vs 102.65. Yld 6.27 vs 6.24 *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 70 bps vs 71 bps
